scope: Original six product cases per source/merge lane with passive CDP events. Distinct from the prior 12 synthetic-WASM local transport diagnostics. No workflow retry or source change.

sdk_raw_error_messages.text: [makepad][http][err] GET http://127.0.0.1:4175/api/hepta/owner-status AbortError: signal is aborted without reason tiles=-
[makepad][http][err] GET http://127.0.0.1:4175/api/hepta/owner-status AbortError: signal is aborted without reason tiles=-

observed_facts: Original source lane 6 cases: 5 passed, the 640 timeout case timed out; base lane original same 6 cases: 6 passed. No skipped or flaky cases in either report.

Source runtime request 21200.22 has 503 no-store, Content-Length 79 and 79-byte dataReceived; SDK503 then native net::ERR_ABORTED (canceled=true) occurred before the original response.finished wait began.
Native failure was already observed 802.306ms before the timeout-runtime.finished start marker. The later page.unrouteAll closed-page cleanup error is not the initiating native failure.
The separate source owner request 21200.21 was canceled as required by the timeout scenario; its event must not be confused with runtime 21200.22.
Source and base tested tree and all twelve whole manifest byte sequences are equal. Source has one unexpected runtime native failure; base has none.
The failed source case reached the Timed Out pixel/OCR proof, but never reached held-owner.finish or completed late-owner/cancellation qualification.
Both source and base original job conclusions are now terminal: source failure, base success; the lock-review job also succeeded.

causal_inference.assessment: The actual source event sequence strongly matches the separately reproduced and upstream-fixed Chromium response-body terminal-state reentry defect. The association is supported by the pinned SDK EOF source review and original-browser local controls; it is not a captured unique C++ call-chain proof.
causal_inference.actual_upstream_fix: Publish the ReadableStreamBytesConsumer result/terminal state with HandleResult(result) before reentering bytes_consumer_client_->OnStateChange(); new CancelAfterDone and CancelAfterError tests preserve terminal semantics.
causal_inference.sdk_eof_review: Pinned Makepad HTTP read loop does not unconditionally cancel or abort on natural EOF; the observed SDK503 path must not be repaired by blindly removing required active-request/limit/truncation cancellation.
causal_inference.playwright_wait_relation: Playwright 1.63.0 requestfailed stores/emits failure without resolving the response finished promise, whereas requestfinished resolves it. A previously observed native failure can therefore leave this original finished wait until the whole-test deadline/target close.

not_proven: No C++ stack was captured; alternative native causes have not been ruled out uniquely.
Exact byte count and SDK503 do not independently validate every response-body byte. No new body interception was introduced.
ZIPs contain manifests and receipts rather than SDK/WASM/gateway executables; their executable digests are recorded by CI, while the ZIP and manifest digests were independently verified locally.
A successful base lane with the same tree does not negate the failed source lane or demonstrate that the timing-dependent defect is fixed.
The prior 12 synthetic-WASM local diagnostics are distinct from these original 12 product executions and do not replace any original gate.
All repository check runs are not terminal in the latest snapshot; no claim that 52 checks passed.

constrained_next_step.proposal: Review an isolated backport of the actual upstream Chromium terminal-state fix, or a deliberately approved browser baseline incorporating it. Keep the original failed 153 artifacts as regression input and require the original six product cases in both source and merge lanes on the resulting candidate.
acceptance_invariants: Original 90000ms whole-test deadline and original 27 expect assertions remain.
HTTP no-store and the existing bounded streaming body handling remain.
True truncation, declared/streamed oversize and explicit active owner cancellation remain failures/cancellations.
Runtime completion must remain native-completed; SDK503 or OCR success alone cannot satisfy it.
Do not change route-release order, swallow transport errors, skip a case or use diagnostic Chromium157 as a substitute pass.
constrained_next_step.optional_diagnosis_only: A request-identity-bound failure observation can expose the existing native failure sooner while retaining strict native success. It is not the underlying transport fix and no such change has been applied.
